title: Sukhothai vs Ayutthaya: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Sukhothai for peaceful cycling and fewer crowds, Ayutthaya for easy accessibility from Bangkok and iconic drama.

categories.name: Accessibility
categories.summary: 1.5h from Bangkok by train for 20 THB vs 7h bus from Bangkok.

categories.name: Cycling
categories.summary: Dedicated car-free paths; Ayutthaya shares roads with traffic.

categories.name: Crowds
categories.summary: Sukhothai gets far fewer tourists than Ayutthaya.

categories.name: Temple Impressiveness
categories.summary: Sukhothai is more beautiful; Ayutthaya is more dramatic.

categories.name: Daily Cost
categories.summary: Ayutthaya slightly cheaper after accounting for travel costs.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Si Satchanalai is a hidden gem; Ayutthaya lacks strong day trip options.

categories.name: Loy Krathong
categories.summary: The festival originated in Sukhothai and is celebrated spectacularly here.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Sukhothai noodles (kuay teow Sukhothai) are a genuine regional dish.

categories.name: Overall Atmosphere
categories.summary: More serene, less touristy, more rewarding for those who make the trip.

faq.question: Should I visit Sukhothai or Ayutthaya?
faq.answer: Ayutthaya for accessibility and a day trip from Bangkok. Sukhothai if you have 2+ nights and want fewer crowds.

faq.question: Can you do Ayutthaya as a day trip from Bangkok?
faq.answer: Yes. Train from Hua Lamphong takes 1.5–2h for 15–20 THB. Sukhothai requires 7h bus or flight.

faq.question: Which ruins are more impressive?
faq.answer: Sukhothai is more beautiful; Ayutthaya is more dramatic with the iconic Buddha head in tree roots.
